fields.System.Title: Validate rows
fields.System.Description: As an admin, I want invalid rows reported with a reason, so that I can fix them and import them again.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
1. A row without a name is rejected.
  2. A row whose email is not a valid email address is rejected.
  3. Every rejected row appears in the error report with its row number and the reason.
